description: Create or update a shelving record placing a book on one of the caller's shelves, writing to their own PDS via this AppView. The record key is derived from the book and shelf. A book can be placed on a shelf at most once.

shelf.description: AT-URI of the shelf record in the caller's repo.

book.description: AT-URI of the catalog book to place on the shelf.

metadata.description: Metadata about this book's relationship to the shelf.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: The book is not in the released catalog, or the shelf record does not exist in the caller's repo.
